description: This file implements a local filesystem backend for file storage, including methods for copying, reading, writing, moving, deleting files and directories, as well as creating zip archives of files or directories. It is part of the Mattermost server's file storage system.

classes.name: LocalFileBackend
classes.description: A struct representing a local filesystem backend for file storage, with methods to manipulate files and directories.

methods.name: DriverName
methods.description: Returns the name of the driver, which is 'driverLocal'.

methods.name: TestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the local filesystem by attempting to write and delete a test file.

methods.name: Reader
methods.description: Opens a file for reading, returning a ReadCloseSeeker.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a byte slice.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the specified file.

methods.name: FileModTime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of the specified file.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies a file from oldPath to newPath within the local storage.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from oldPath to newPath within the local storage.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data from an io.Reader to a file at the specified path.

methods.name: AppendFile
methods.description: Appends data from an io.Reader to an existing file.

methods.name: ListDirectory
methods.description: Lists files and directories at the specified path.

methods.name: ListDirectoryRecursively
methods.description: Recursively lists files and directories starting from the specified path.

methods.name: RemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents.

methods.name: ZipReader
methods.description: Creates a zip archive of a file or directory, streaming it as an io.ReadCloser.
